name: CacheAnalyzer
description: Discover cacheable same-origin targets, then reliably stage cache poisoning and deception checks through profiling, broad screening, and exact-marker cache-hit proof.

actions.name: scan
actions.description: Probe one saved request for poisoning and deception behaviors, requiring clean-control confirmation.

marker.description: Unique per-run marker generated by the caller.

target_url.description: Optional same-origin target URL when the saved base exchange must not pre-fill the cache key under test.

target_key_mode.description: Internal discovery result describing whether the selected target accepts isolated query cache busters or only its exact shared URL.

target_queue.description: Internal bounded queue of additional cacheable targets selected by discovery.

deception_base_url.description: Internal original-page target retained when poisoning moves to a discovered resource.

allow_cache_side_effects.description: Explicit acknowledgement that the test may create isolated cache entries.

scan_mode.description: Light directly confirms a small high-yield header set. Full screens the complete bundled header list, confirms attributed candidates, then exposes an advanced-family follow-up.

phase.description: Staged phase. Omit to discover cacheable same-origin targets before Full screening or Light confirmation; normally copy this from result.follow_up.

max_discovery_targets.description: Maximum same-origin page-discovered targets to profile in addition to the saved URL.

screen_cursor.description: Opaque Full-screen continuation cursor copied from result.follow_up.

screen_candidate_headers.description: Accumulated attributed header candidates copied between paginated screen follow-ups.

screen_candidate_parameters.description: Accumulated attributed query candidates copied between paginated screen follow-ups.

prior_candidate_headers.description: Internal bounded candidate context retained for the terminal advanced result.

oracle_families.description: Run only the selected poisoning oracle families. Omit to preserve the broad default scan.

headers.description: Additional candidate header names or Param Miner-style name~value templates. Use %s or %h in custom values to retain candidate-specific marker proof.

use_only_supplied_headers.description: Internal follow-up control that prevents re-adding built-in or bundled headers during candidate confirmation.

header_bucket_size.description: Number of typed, independently marked headers per Full screening request.

parameter_bucket_size.description: Number of independently marked query parameters per bounded Full screening request.

header_combinations.description: Explicit bounded sets of headers to send together as name or name~value templates.

full_query_oracle.description: Test whether the entire query string is excluded from the cache key by comparing against the query-free URL.

allow_shared_cache_key_tests.description: Additional acknowledgement required because full-query tests cannot isolate the query-free cache key.

shared_header_cache_key_oracle.description: Preserve the exact target URL for header probes when strict cacheability rejects query busters. Requires allow_shared_cache_key_tests=true and marker-only confirmation.

url_normalization_oracle.description: Use harmless raw angle-bracket paths and browser-encoded equivalents to test normalized cache-key collisions in two independent trials.

fat_get_parameters.description: Explicit form body parameters to test on a GET request for unkeyed-body poisoning.

parameter_names.description: Additional query/body parameter names, evaluated before the bundled parameter list.

confirmed_query_parameters.description: Confirmed unkeyed query parameters propagated to advanced fat-GET and cloaking tests.

known_root_causes.description: Internal follow-up state used to suppress root causes already persisted by an earlier scan stage.

cookie_names.description: Explicit cookie names to test for unkeyed cookie poisoning. No cookies are tested by default.

use_cookie_wordlist.description: Use the bundled non-authentication cookie candidates in Full advanced scans; set false to skip them.

allow_sensitive_cookie_mutation.description: Required in addition to an explicit name before session, authentication, token, or CSRF cookies may be mutated.

poison_attempts.description: Bounded repeated poison requests sent before clean confirmation to catch short cache-expiry windows.

poison_interval_ms.description: Cancel-aware delay before each poison retry; requires host delay support.

path_delimiters.description: Literal or percent-encoded delimiters to test before a static-looking suffix.

static_directories.description: Static-directory cache prefixes for encoded traversal normalization probes.

exact_cache_files.description: Exactly cached filenames for cache-normalization probes.

normalization_delimiters.description: Origin delimiters placed before encoded traversal sequences.
